evidence: (a) No equivalent commit boundary found: CURRENT-DESIGN.md:14 gives the plugin a serialized writer for graph state, while DESIGN-NOTES.md:27-28 place the shared Beads database in the same repository but give Beads ownership of work; DESIGN-NOTES.md:134 explicitly asks how graph/Beads updates are coordinated in Git, and CURRENT-DESIGN.md:56 still lists the persistence boundary as future design. DESIGN-NOTES.md:150 makes the plugin the sole graph-state writer and Git committer, without saying how Beads-owned changes enter its queue or are committed. (b) The accepted separation of work tracking from graph (CURRENT-DESIGN.md:9; DESIGN-NOTES.md:186-187; HERDR-GRAPH-VISION.md:125) resolves task ownership, not same-checkout persistence. (c) The claim stays within the adopted shared-repository scope in DESIGN-NOTES.md:27 and SOFTWARE-FACTORY-VISION.md:59; it asks for a commit ownership/interface contract, not for graph to run project tasks. (d) It is material to the stated shared work record and cross-session continuity (SOFTWARE-FACTORY-VISION.md:31,149), because the design does not yet say how work-record changes coexist with graph's single Git committer. This is an acknowledged design-stage gap, not evidence of actual data loss or a claim that implementation is ready.
